result: Resolved architectural distinction between standalone discrete verification model HybridRouteAutomaton and live operational route controller DriveState in SwitchingSolver. HybridRouteAutomaton is explicitly documented as a standalone / experimental discrete verification model and contract reference. DriveState in switching.rs is documented as the live operational route controller. Comprehensive tests added in hybrid_automaton_contracts verifying positive and negative routing controls, state preservation, time mark preservation, tolerance preservation, and work invariants (WorkCounters), as well as SwitchingSolver live dispatch traces with work conservation.
limitations: HybridRouteAutomaton remains a standalone discrete verification model rather than an integrated runtime stepper state machine.
Overall qualification verdict remains HOLD_NOT_RELEASE_QUALIFIED pending remaining qualification and remediation tasks.
